主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. reported a net income of $5.2 billion in its February 2015 filing. The report was submitted as part of a Form 6-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing includes an exhibit, Exhibit 99.1, which is incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. on Form F-10 (File No. 333-198444). The report was signed by A.J. Silber, the Corporate Secretary of Brookfield Asset Management Inc., on February 13, 2015. This filing is part of the company's ongoing compliance with U.S. securities regulations.
